chains.title: GABPA binds the C228T-created ETS motif and activates TERT
chains.element: TERT promoter C228T creates a de novo ETS/GGAA motif at the variant.

links.claim: GABPA binds the alt allele more strongly than the ref allele at TERT promoter C228T. No QBiC-SELEX model is supplied for GABPA here; this direction is inferred from the C228T-created ETS/GGAA motif and known TERT promoter biology, not from a QBiC-SELEX measurement.
The variant lies in the TERT promoter and creates an ETS-factor binding element.
In glioblastoma cells, this promoter element can drive TERT expression.
Increased TERT expression supports telomere maintenance and tumor cell immortality, promoting glioblastoma.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher GABPA ChIP signal than ref allele at the variant.
TERT expression is higher from the alt-bearing allele.
GABPA knockdown reduces TERT expression and/or the allelic TERT expression bias.
falsified_if: No reproducible GABPA occupancy over the variant in C228T-bearing cells.
No alt-allele enrichment in GABPA ChIP at the variant.
GABPA knockdown does not reduce TERT expression or does not remove the allelic TERT expression bias.

chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect at C228T
predictions: No allele-specific GABPA, ETS1, or ELK1 ChIP signal over the variant.
No alt-specific TERT expression from the variant.
Any disease association is due to a linked causal variant, passenger mutation, or another non-TF mechanism.
falsified_if: Reproducible allele-specific occupancy of an ETS factor at the variant is demonstrated.
The alt allele shows a reproducible increase in TERT expression that depends on the variant.
Knockdown of the candidate ETS factor removes the allelic TERT expression bias.

matrix.test: Allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for GABPA at the TERT promoter in C228T-heterozygous glioblastoma cells, with spike-in normalization; compare alt/ref DNA ratios in GABPA immunoprecipitate.

outcomes.outcome: GABPA ChIP alt/ref > 1 at the variant; TERT expression higher from alt allele; GABPA knockdown reduces TERT and allelic bias.
ETS1 ChIP alt/ref > 1; GABPA ChIP alt/ref approximately 1 or weaker; ETS1 knockdown reduces TERT.
ELK1 ChIP alt/ref > 1; GABPA and ETS1 ChIP alt/ref approximately 1 or weaker; ELK1 knockdown reduces TERT.
No allele-specific GABPA, ETS1, or ELK1 ChIP signal; no alt-specific TERT expression.

next_experiment: Allele-specific ChIP-qPCR for GABPA at TERT promoter C228T in heterozygous glioblastoma cells. The GABPA_activation chain predicts alt/ref > 1 in GABPA immunoprecipitate; the null predicts no allelic imbalance (alt/ref approximately 1). This is the cheapest direct separator of the top two chains.
